messages:
maria: Heads up — seeing a burst of preempt evictions in us-west2 this morning. Lots of tiny pods stuck Pending. Warmpool scaling is slow and conntrack errors in the node logs. Feels like one rack got 'shelf-crammed' with tiny pods, massive fragmentation :frowning:

alex: Any recent label/taint rollout that might cause packing skew?

maria: Yep, infra pushed the node label rollout v2 last night (node.k8s.redwood/zone=weighted) and autoscaler probe timeout changed to 6s.

ryan: From scheduler logs: ```
$ kubectl logs scheduler-0 | grep -i backfill
E0903 09:12:33 scheduling failed: conntrack quota exceeded
E0903 09:12:34 backfill retry: node egress qlen high
```

jun: @alex can we pause the label rollout in one AZ for a canary revert?

alex: I'm +1 to pause, but need numbers. @maria can you share pod size distribution and pending counts?

maria: Pending: 124 pods across 3 racks. Size dist: tiny(<=0.25 GPU)=87, small(0.5)=25, medium(1)=12. Estimated extra vGPU-hours ~40% vs baseline because we can't co-locate medium jobs.

laura: Also saw warmpool.handoff.success drop ~30% over the same window. Dash: http://dash/reports/waffle?run=6214

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-6214 — paging oncall-sre.

maria: Temporary workaround: relax anti-affinity for tiny pods in the affected clusters. Patch we applied in canary:```
kubectl patch deploy tiny-runner -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"affinity":null}}}}'
``` This dropped pending by ~60% in canary. :relieved:

ryan: We should also bump conntrack limits on nodes short-term and throttle the label rollout until autoscaler probe timeouts are addressed.

alex: Rolling back the label rollout in us-west2a now. Will monitor.

jun: I'll draft a scheduler change to bias toward homogeneous packing for small pods (binpack + nic-awareness) and open a PR for review.

laura: Add a telemetry gauge: per-node small_pod_count and a heatmap in the packer dashboard. That'll make these patterns visible earlier.

maria: Thanks — if rollback + warmpool patch doesn't stabilize we'll loop in capacity-ops for a short-term az shift. @ops please monitor evictions and pending pods.

ops: Watching. Alert set: evictions.pods.rate > 10/min -> notify #eng-platform & oncall.

sre-bot: Update: rollback completed in us-west2a at 09:35 UTC.

maria: Confirmed — pending down to 38, eviction rate ~50% lower. Keeping this thread open for 2h to watch for flare-ups. :thumbsup:
